rationale: Independent two-workload missing-feedback stress test revealed repeated selection of the unavailable workload without any observed reward; this is a robustness guard, not a tuned reward.
rule: After null feedback, try one other nonexhausted workload if one exists; then the former workload can compete normally. Known zero does not trigger this rule.
rewardAndLearning: Identical raw configured weighted score. Null consumes budget and updates neither model parameters nor GA parent population.
comparison: Same frozen references and three baseline traces; original unguarded contextual traces retained separately. No application executions; no outcomes discarded; no tuning to comparison outcomes.
